A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
walking is a very effective way to improve health, and the aerobic demand is an important parameter to determine the intensity of the activity.
the aerobic demand of children walking on a treadmill at a self-selected pace is related to their body weight and height.
the aerobic demands of walking in kids are predicted by a number of factors including age, gender, height, weight, body composition, and fitness level.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the aerobic demands of walking and running are not as different as we once believed.
the aerobic demand of a given walking speed is not constant across individuals and is highly dependent on body size.
the prediction of the aerobic demand for walking in children should be improved.
